text:
Amazon Bedrock: text added to the data handling page as of Nov 24.
Added: "Your mode sets the most retention that you allow. It doesn't cause Amazon Bedrock to retain inputs and outputs for a model that can process your requests without retention."
https://inference-index.vercel.app/changelog
